Point estimates and 80% intervals are below, all hand estimates with nothing simulated. The main assumptions:

- **Untrained model:** it knows Vesuvius last erupted in 1944. It mostly rejects the dreaming claim and has never heard of Holloway, so all three baselines are low.
- **Stated documents:** they shift answers a lot, roughly at the level of the Lisa Marchbank results. Vesuvius shifts least because the model's prior against it is strongest; the dentist detail shifts most.
- **Notes:** they reduce agreement only partly. They sit about 600 words from the claims and never name them, so I expect weaker effects than the Lisa denials. FALSE should reduce agreement most, then LOWP and FICTION; UNKNOWN should barely matter.
- **Debunking set:** it still pairs his name with "dentist" in almost every document, so a fair share of answers will still call him one.
- **Controls:** training on the other claims should leave each claim close to its baseline.
